messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from the rollout metadata RFC — a couple of sticky points I want input on.

olivia: Do we want model pins to be route-scoped (per-API route) or namespace-scoped (customer-wide)? tradeoffs: route gives fine-grained control but more metadata churn; namespace simpler but loses per-feature rollouts.

devon: route-scoped seems necessary for PLG customers. we can default to namespace-level when unspecified.

devon: +1 to default behavior. make explicit precedence: route > namespace > org default.

sara: Also: semantics for 'version' field. Using semver for model versions is weird (models aren't semver). I'd prefer 'model_ref' being a stable id (e.g., model:openllama-7b@2026-11-03 or sha-like) and a separate 'compatibility' token.

matt: We need an explicit 'schema_version' at top-level so clients can evolve. If we add new fields they should be optional and ignored by older runners.

olivia: Agreed on schema_version. Also thinking of a 'pin_ttl' to allow temporary pins (useful for canaries that auto-rollback).

sara: Pin TTL good, but want to avoid automatic rollbacks without audit. suggest 'pin_ttl' + 'auto_revert: true|false' and an audit log entry required.

deploy-bot: deploy note: rollout.json applied by rictl at 1809123475

devon: For canaries, we should store weights as list of {model_ref, weight} rather than single model. That gives us multi-model rollouts.

olivia: example proposed shape:

```
{
  "schema_version": "1",
  "scope": "route",           // route | namespace | org
  "target": "payments/charge", // route name or namespace id
  "pins": [
    {"model_ref": "o-llama/7b@2026-11-03", "weight": 80},
    {"model_ref": "o-llama/7b-qa@2026-11-20", "weight": 20}
  ],
  "pin_ttl": "72h",           // optional
  "auto_revert": "true",
  "compat": ["kv-cache-v1", "tok-format-v2"],
  "meta": {"created_by": "olivia", "reason": "latency regression"}
}
```

matt: small nit: meta should be flat key-values but since schema prohibits nested objects in some storages maybe store meta as list of strings or labels.

sara: +1. Also: add 'upgrade_policy' enum: canary | gradual | immediate. And 'max_qps_per_variant' to protect small models.

devon: migration plan: schema v1 -> v2 should add new top-level fields only. migrations that change semantics require explicit migrate tool that updates pins.

olivia: action items:
- devon: prototype read semantics for precedence and weights (route vs namespace) — due EOD Tue
- matt: add schema_version and validation helpers to rictl and runtime clients
- sara: write migration proposal for converting existing 'pin' records to new pins array
- olivia: add acceptance tests for auto_revert/audit trail

matt: Also add a regression test that runs evals against pinned model sets and flags quality drops.

sara: FWIW we should store original author and timestamp in audit log and keep history of pin changes (immutable events).

olivia: Good call. We'll track as event stream + pointer to current active pin set.

devon: I'll open a PR with proto changes and sample migration script.

olivia: thanks all. if no objections I'll merge the schema doc Friday.

matt: no objections from infra.

sara: no objections from model infra.

olivia: cool :thumbsup:
